lines.say: A Twinkies box cost five dollars. Saturday, three were listed for three hundred.
Hostess had just announced it was closing for good, and the shelves went crazy.
One guy cleaned out a Walgreens Friday night, then hit Target the next morning.
Look, he didn't love Twinkies any more on Saturday. He just noticed they could be gone.
caps: He didn't love them more Saturday.
He just *noticed they could be gone.*

lines.say: Your regulars are the same, so text him at week three, while his chair's still open.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
